text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Jalan Persekutuan

(Lebuh Raya Pantai Timur-Fasa 2) 2011.

 (2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 22 Ogos 2011.

Perisytiharan jalan sebagai jalan Persekutuan

2. (1) Bahagian jalan yang dikenali sebagai Lebuh Raya Pantai Timur-Fasa 2

yang bermula—

(a) dari kilometer 365.544 di Persimpangan Bertingkat Bukit Besi

(di koordinat U -15392.721, T +33595.713 Grid Cassini Negeri

Terengganu) dan berakhir di kilometer 403.748 di Persimpangan

Bertingkat Ajil (di koordinat U +15900.344, T +18910.634 Grid Cassini

Negeri Terengganu) (kedua-dua jarak diukur dari Pejabat Pos Besar Kuala

Lumpur melalui Lebuh Raya Kuala Lumpur-Karak, Lebuh Raya Pantai

Timur – Fasa 1 dan Lebuh Raya Pantai Timur – Fasa 2) termasuklah jalanjalan sambungannya, iaitu suatu jarak sepanjang 38.204 kilometer; dan

(b) dari kilometer 423.246 di Persimpangan Bertingkat Telemung

(di koordinat U +32846.487, T +12686.520 Grid Cassini Negeri

Terengganu) dan berakhir di kilometer 424.793 (di koordinat

U +34307.904, T +13156.195 Grid Cassini Negeri Terengganu)

termasuklah Persimpangan Jalan Telemung, iaitu suatu jarak sepanjang

1.547 kilometer,

diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan.

 (2) Jalan yang diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan di bawah

subperenggan (1) ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

[Subperenggan 2(2)]

PETA LEBUH RAYA PANTAI TIMUR-FASA 2

Dibuat 16 Julai 2011

[KKR.PUU.110-1/7/3/2; PN(PU2)391/XXIII]

 DATO' SHAZIMAN BIN ABU MANSOR

Menteri Kerja Raya

[Akan dibentangkan di Dewan Rakyat di bawah seksyen 4 Akta Jalan Persekutuan 1959]

FEDERAL ROADS ACT 1959

FEDERAL ROADS (EAST COAST EXPRESSWAY-PHASE 2) ORDER 2011

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 3 of the Federal Roads Act 1959

[Act 376], the Minister, after consultation with the State Government of Terengganu,

makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (East Coast ExpresswayPhase 2) Order 2011.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 22 August 2011.

Declaration of road to be Federal road

2. (1) That part of the road known as the East Coast Expressway-Phase 2

commencing―

(a) from kilometre 365.544 at Bukit Besi Interchange (at coordinates

N -15392.721, E +33595.713 of the Terengganu State Cassini Grid) and

ending at kilometre 403.748 at Ajil Interchange (at coordinates

N +15900.344, E +18910.634 of the Terengganu State Cassini Grid) (both

distances measured from the General Post Office Kuala Lumpur via Kuala

Lumpur-Karak Highway, East Coast Expressway – Phase 1 and East Coast

Expressway–Phase 2) including its link roads, being a distance of 38.204

kilometres; and

(b) from kilometre 423.246 at Telemung Interchange (at coordinates

N +32846.487, E +12686.520 of the Terengganu State Cassini Grid) and

ending at kilometre 424.793 (at coordinates N +34307.904,

E +13156.195 of the Terengganu State Cassini Grid) including Telemung

Road Junction, being a distance of 1.547 kilometres,

is declared to be a Federal road.

 (2) The road declared to be a Federal road under subparagraph (1) is shown

on the map in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

[Subparagraph 2(2)]

MAP OF EAST COAST EXPRESSWAY-PHASE 2

Made 16 July 2011

[KKR.PUU.110-1/7/3/2; PN(PU2)391/XXIII]

 DATO' SHAZIMAN BIN ABU MANSOR

Minister of Works
